author: Julien Chaumond
subtitle: Co-founder at Hugging Face
content: Excited to announce multi-token prediction support is now in llama.cpp! This significantly speeds up inference on consumer hardware. Try it out with --predict-multi-token flag.

author: Marcelo Rovai
subtitle: Professor & AI Researcher
content: Running Gemma4 on a Raspberry Pi 5 — full walkthrough on edge inference. The 4-bit quantized model fits in 6GB RAM and achieves 8 tokens/sec. Full tutorial: https://hackster.io/gemma4-rpi5

author: Abhishek Veeramalla
subtitle: Simplifying MLOps
content: Kubernetes Day 2 operations checklist: node autoscaling, PodDisruptionBudgets, multi-cluster networking. Most teams skip PDBs and regret it during rolling deploys.

author: Swyx
subtitle: Latent Space Podcast
content: The open source AI stack is converging faster than I expected. vLLM, llama.cpp, and Ollama are all solving the same inference problem from different angles. Winner will be determined by ecosystem, not benchmarks.

author: Lior Ben David
subtitle: AI Tools Curator
content: 10 open source tools that replaced paid SaaS for my team this year: Grafana (Datadog), Metabase (Tableau), n8n (Zapier), Minio (S3), Gitea (GitHub). Full list in comments.
